creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 while building MUSTER_RESUME (a_2hIfv4FTx). The variable applies only to agents whose manifest has a [session] resume, Claude Code today, because a named {args} needs the manifest's flag lists and the manifest gives a fallback. Codex already reports its session id, so a Codex started through a wrapper could name its own resume the same way, without {args}. Low until a Codex wrapper needs it.
title: MUSTER_RESUME for agents whose manifest names no resume
